scripts.build: bun run build:theatre && bun run build:konva && bun run build:backstage
scripts.build:backstage: bun build backstage-terminal.ts --target browser --format iife --outdir ../ui/vendor/backstage && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/LICENSE ../ui/vendor/backstage/xterm-LICENSE && cp node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/LICENSE ../ui/vendor/backstage/addon-fit-LICENSE
scripts.build:konva: bun build stage-canvas.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile ../ui/vendor/konva.bundle.js && cp node_modules/konva/LICENSE ../ui/vendor/konva-LICENSE
